title: Restricted native proper scalar mate on bounded-below complexes
statement: Fix a prime l and normalized native inverse-image data NativeRings. Let E be a finite unlifted coefficient index in the algebraic closure and a the compatible completed-to-native coefficient Change whose maps equal every normalized integralMap. For a proper morphism g:U to V and a bounded-below derived module M over the completed ring on U, the image under derived restriction along a.map V of the component (properComparison(a,g))_M is invertible.

proof.text: Use the coefficient-presentation theorem to identify the actual native scalar mate, as an arrow, with an exact equivalence applied to the composite of the integral-to-field and field-to-closure mates. This comparison is available without properness or boundedness.

Choose a cohomological lower bound b for M. The exact source equivalence e preserves this bound. The integral localization extension is exact by padicIntegers_invertEll, so its left derived functor also preserves the same lower bound, using its natural isomorphism with the induced exact derived functor.

A proper g is qcqs, so the existing localizedDirectImageComparison_isIso applies to e(M). Apply the bounded proper finite-field-to-algebraic-closure derivedPushHom theorem to its scalar extension with lower bound b. The two comparison components, their images by functors, and their composite are invertible. Arrow.isIso_iff_isIso_of_isIso transfers this invertibility to properComparison(a,g) at M; derived restriction preserves isomorphisms, giving the stated restricted comparison.

theorem native_proper_scalar_mate_bounded_below_restricted
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [N : NativeRings.{u} l]
    (E : Index l (PadicAlgCl l))
    (a : PurCompactSupport.Change (PurCompactSupport.completed l
      (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)) (nativeCoefficients l))
    (ha : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u})
      (C : CoefficientPresentation l T (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E) (embedding l E)),
      a.map T = C.integralMap l T)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V) [IsProper g]
    (M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules U
      ((PurCompactSupport.completed l (Coefficient.{u} l (PadicAlgCl l) E)).ring U)))
    (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus M) :
    IsIso ((pbcDerivedRestrict (a.map V)).map
      ((PurCompactSupport.properComparison a g).app M))
